app.name: Kitchen
app.description: Your kitchen assistant: tell it what changed, and it keeps track.

noSession.title: You're signed out
noSession.body: Open the unlock page and enter your access code to continue.

errorPage.title: Something didn't load
errorPage.body: Your kitchen is safe. Try loading the page again.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.empty: Your kitchen is empty. Tell me what you've got.
kitchen.stale: Offline · showing your kitchen as of {time}
kitchen.addedDaysAgo: {days, plural, =0 {added today} =1 {added yesterday} other {added # days ago}}

chat.label: Chat
chat.heading: Chat with Kitchen
chat.welcome: Hi! Tell me what you bought, froze or used up. I save things as soon as you tell me, and you can always Undo.
chat.errorNothingChanged: I couldn't save that, so nothing changed.
chat.interrupted: Reply interrupted. Your changes were saved.

receipt.title: What changed
receipt.cantUndo: Can't undo this now. Tell me what to fix.

msg.ITEM_RECORDED: {name} wasn't in your kitchen, so I added it
msg.ITEM_USED_RECORDED: {name} wasn't in your kitchen; noted it as used
msg.UNKNOWN_ITEM: That item isn't in this kitchen
msg.EVIDENCE_NOT_FOUND: I couldn't find that in what you typed
msg.NOT_SAID: Allergies and diets are saved only when you say them
msg.STALE_TARGET: That changed since; please check and try again
msg.UNDO_CONFLICT: Can't undo this now: something changed it since. Tell me what to fix.
msg.UNDO_OF_UNDO: An undo can't be undone; tell me what to fix
msg.INVALID_PROPOSAL: I couldn't understand that change, so nothing changed
msg.SAVE_FAILED: I couldn't save that, so nothing changed

unlock.title: Kitchen
unlock.intro: Welcome in. Enter your access code to open your kitchen.
unlock.label: Access code
unlock.staySignedIn: You'll stay signed in on this device.

errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait {minutes} min and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Access codes aren't set up on this server yet.
errors.wrong: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
